title: Fix documentation inaccuracies found in review (cli.md, Codex docs, diagrams)
description:
**Found by:** post-PR-#7 review of the docs against `src/cli/mod.rs` and `src/adapters/codex.rs`.

**Intent:** docs-only correction set (no code changes). Bring the docs in line with what the code does today and mark planned-but-unimplemented behavior clearly as planned under BOTSPY-98386a.

**Scope:**
1. `docs/cli.md`: document only the five implemented verbs (sources, sessions, show, doctor, snapshot); mark search/import/stats/watch plus the unimplemented flags as planned under BOTSPY-98386a; note `botspy scan` is added separately; fix the store.db claim (CLI reads live adapters through an in-memory SessionStore); fix the kebab-case-aliases claim (exact names only); fix the sources discovery/skip-stats claim.
2. Codex docs (`docs/sources/codex.md`, `docs/sensitive-data.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/diagrams/codex.d2`): document what the code actually does — no `thread_history_1.sqlite` open, in-memory byte offsets, swallowed `parent_id` schema-drift error (0 sessions on real installs, open bug BOTSPY-81143b), live `state_5.sqlite` open without snapshot protection; fix the blanket snapshot-protection claim.
3. `docs/sources/README.md`: Codex registry root is `~/.codex/sessions`, not `~/.codex`.
4. Re-render changed diagrams with `scripts/render-diagrams.sh`; commit .d2/.svg/.light.png/.dark.png together.

**Out of scope:** `docs/DESIGN.md`, any code changes, main branch.

**Acceptance:** docs match code references cited in the review; rendered diagram artifacts committed with sources; PR to develop, CI green, merged. GitFlow: never main.
